lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gill region, with 3 to 5 nodes per column forming a regular 2D grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance are present, intersecting the primary circular blobs to form a rectilinear pattern of high-intensity anchor nodes across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear features are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-frequency distribution of smaller, lower-magnitude circular spots that contrast with the larger, more sparse constellation pattern observed on the primary flank.
